First tagged release. The image has been building and shipping for a while, it just never had a version number.

## ✨ Added

- A wrapper image around the official Euro Office Document Server that fixes one thing the upstream build leaves broken. The vendor's own Dockerfile has the `chown -R ds:ds` step for the `Data` volume commented out, while `docservice`, `adminpanel` and `converter` all run as the unprivileged `ds` user. On a freshly bind-mounted `Data` folder, which is exactly what Unraid creates, those services hit a permission error on their own state files.
- The fix is one extra supervisor program that re-asserts the volume's ownership during the first seconds of boot, before the `ds-*` services start. `ENTRYPOINT` and the vendor's `entrypoint.sh` are untouched.
- The house init banner in the container log, so the start is visible rather than silent.
- Images for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, built from the pinned upstream tag.

## ⚡ Improved

- The documentation lives here now, next to the image it describes. It used to sit in the feed repository and said this repository held only Community Applications metadata, which stopped being true when the image got its own build.
- The README explains what the image adds and why, which the old text left out entirely.
